summary.text: Lance Neelly is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 42 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He has worked as a correctional officer at a maximum-security prison and as a security supervisor, and he is vice chair of the Agriculture Committee.

paragraphs.text: Neelly was born in Hutchinson, Kansas, and lives in Tonganoxie, Kansas.
He graduated from Burrton High School and attended Hutchinson Community College.
His career experience includes working as a correctional officer for a maximum-security prison and as a security supervisor.
Neelly took office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Representative Jim Karleskint.
During the 2025-2026 session he served on the Corrections and Juvenile Justice and Financial Institutions and Pensions committees and as vice chair of the Agriculture Committee.
